I requested the documents from the customer, who expects to provide them in about 6 business days. I did not open the account or book the M$5,100 deposit.

Mckenzie Garcia said she can't approve KYC/AML exceptions and wants the numbers. The branch will likely finish at 58 of 59 unless this lead clears in time, and it can't under the current documents. I did not bypass the policy to close the gap. If Mckenzie wants this escalated, that goes to Compliance.

I've saved the handover note for the next shift. It records the open items: the account is still pending documents, and the deposit has not been booked.
